queries: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(g.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(g.avg_modindex - a.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_overall FROM telescope_weather AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE g.avg_modindex > a.avg_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile
